title: Enclosed Loops: How open source communities become datasets
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on the socio-technical dynamics of open-source software communities, centralization, and the transformation of these communities into datasets for tools like Dependabot, Crater, and Copilot.
